fields.title: Search-result / listing-detail record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Point2Homes' own schema.org JSON-LD (`RentAction`) shape. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "search" mode with fetchDetails=false emits a lighter summary card per listing (price range, address, one image, url); fetchDetails=true (default) and "listing" mode both emit the full detail-page record (description, bed/bath/floor-plan breakdown, agent name, photo gallery, geo-coordinates).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: search mode: "<propertyType>:<location>" that produced this record. listing mode: the exact listing URL requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-search-summary (lightweight search-result card), S2-detail (full listing/apartment-complex detail page), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. location_not_found, listing_not_found, http_5xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_gridTotal.title: Grid total
_gridTotal.description: S1-search-summary only -- Point2Homes' own reported total match count for this location/propertyType.

position.title: Position
position.description: S1-search-summary only -- 1-based rank within the search-results grid.

@type.title: JSON-LD type
@type.description: Always "RentAction" -- the schema.org action wrapping the rentable property/complex.

agent.title: Listing agent/broker
agent.description: S2-detail only -- {"@type": "RealEstateAgent", "name": "..."}, the property manager/broker/agent name Point2Homes attributes the listing to.

priceSpecification.title: Price
priceSpecification.description: {"minPrice", "maxPrice" (omitted if a single flat price), "priceCurrency"} -- the overall asking rent range for the property/complex.

object.title: Property
object.description: The rentable entity itself -- @type is "SingleFamilyResidence" (house/townhome/condo unit) or "ApartmentComplex" (multi-unit building). Carries name, image, url (canonical listing URL), address (PostalAddress), and on S2-detail records also description, numberOfRooms, numberOfBathroomsTotal, floorSize, petsAllowed, and accommodationFloorPlan (array of per-floor-plan FloorPlan objects, each with numberOfBedrooms/numberOfBathroomsTotal/floorSize/price -- an ApartmentComplex typically lists several).

geoId.title: Geo ID
geoId.description: S2-detail only -- Point2Homes' internal numeric location/neighborhood ID. Not present in JSON-LD; parsed from an HTML data attribute.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: S2-detail only -- parsed from an HTML data attribute, not present in JSON-LD.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: S2-detail only -- parsed from an HTML data attribute, not present in JSON-LD.

internalId.title: Internal listing ID
internalId.description: S2-detail only -- Point2Homes' internal numeric property ID.

companyId.title: Company ID
companyId.description: S2-detail only -- Point2Homes' internal numeric ID for the listing/management company.

propertyShortName.title: Property short name
propertyShortName.description: S2-detail only -- the URL-slug form of the property name.

city.title: City
city.description: S2-detail only -- from the same HTML data attribute as geoId/latitude/longitude (redundant with object.address.addressLocality, kept for convenience).

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: S2-detail only -- full photo-gallery image URLs (placeholder "no-image.png" slots are filtered out; some listings genuinely have only 1 real photo).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-summary and listing-detail records.
